summary: misilva73 提交新 EIP，把 calldata 下限从每字节 64 提到 96 gas，理由是全是转账的区块存在无法降低的字节密度；同时提交 EIP-8279 重构，用显式计数器计量 BAL 字节并加入净零退款。ch4r10t33r 提交 XMSS 等有状态哈希签名密钥的 keystore 格式 EIP。Starknet 就 v0.14.3 中面向 EVM 隐私和量子安全的两项优化发起投票。

items.title: 新 EIP：把 calldata 下限提到 96
items.note: （misilva73）提交，把 calldata 下限从 64/64 提到 96/96 gas 每字节。动机是 21000 gas 的 ETH 转账同时锚定区块的执行和带宽维度，全是转账的区块有约 0.0105 字节每 gas 的不可降低字节密度。
items.title_en: New EIP: Increase Calldata Floor Cost to 96
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted, raising the calldata floor from 64/64 to 96/96 gas per byte. The motivation is that the 21,000-gas ETH transfer anchors both the execution and bandwidth dimensions of a block, and a block full of transfers has an irreducible byte density of about 0.0105 bytes per gas.

items.title: EIP-8279：显式 BAL 数据计量，加入净零退款
items.note: （misilva73）提交。用每笔交易的 `bal_data_bytes` 计数器计量 BAL 字节，只用于下限，不新增 gas 维度，仍按 `max(execution, floor)` 收费；存储值恢复为交易前的值（O→X→O）不收费，连续多次写不同值（A→B→C）只算一次。
items.title_en: EIP-8279: explicit BAL data metering with net-zero refund
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted. BAL bytes are metered in a per-transaction `bal_data_bytes` counter that only feeds the floor, with no new gas dimension and the same `max(execution, floor)` charge; a slot restored to its pre-transaction value (O→X→O) costs nothing, and repeated distinct writes (A→B→C) count once.

items.title: 新 EIP：有状态哈希密钥的后量子 keystore
items.note: （ch4r10t33r）提交，为 lean 以太坊共识层使用的 XMSS 等有状态哈希签名密钥定义 keystore 格式，扩展 EIP-2335，让加密的秘密可以是 XMSS 种子，并加入可消耗密钥所需的机制。
items.title_en: New EIP: Post-Quantum Keystore for Stateful Keys
items.note_en: (ch4r10t33r), submitted, defining a keystore format for stateful hash-based signing keys such as the XMSS used by the lean Ethereum consensus layer. It extends EIP-2335 so the encrypted secret may be an XMSS seed, and adds the machinery a consumable key requires.
